copy.refused: The clipboard refused it, so nothing was copied.

home.wrong: Something did not finish. The Network screen says which.

reason.unknown: Something this build has never heard of. The identifier is in the records.
reason.alreadyOnANetwork: This node is already on a network.
reason.noSuchNetwork: That is not one of the two networks.
reason.nobodyIsThere: The zone names nobody, so there is no network to join yet.
reason.zoneSilent: The zone did not answer, so whether anybody is there is unknown.
reason.theZoneIsUnreadable: The zone answered with something that is not a record this build reads.
reason.seedUnreachable: The node the zone named could not be reached.
reason.seedWouldNotAnswer: The node the zone named would not hand over the network.
reason.seedTooSlow: The node the zone named did not answer in time.
reason.notThePromisedNetwork: What came back is not the network the zone promised.
reason.thereIsANetwork: There is already a network here.
reason.noRandomness: The system would not produce randomness, so there is no key to be.
reason.noClock: This machine puts itself before 1970, so there is no instant to count epochs from.
reason.noDirectory: The system would not say where this node keeps things.
reason.unreadableIdentity: There is a key in the directory and it cannot be read.
reason.unreadableRecord: There is a record in the directory and it cannot be read.
reason.recordDoesNotAddUp: The record no longer holds everything this node has already signed for.
reason.recordWouldNotStart: The record would not take the acts that start it.
reason.formatIsNotFrozen: This build's format is not one a network may be opened on for good.
reason.directoryHeld: Somebody else is already the node in this directory.
reason.directoryCannotBeHeld: This filesystem will not say whether anybody else is in the directory.
reason.noTransport: There is no way to reach that address.
reason.meshAddressUnavailable: The mesh port could not be listened on — usually somebody else has it.
reason.addressUnavailable: The interface address would not bind.
reason.noNetwork: There is no network to do this on.
reason.governmentKeyNotKept: The network opened and its government key could not be kept beside the record.
reason.notErased: The directory would not go, so the node is left whole.

peers.heading: Peers
peers.noNetwork: This node is on no network.
peers.noMesh: This node is on a network and has not taken a port, so nobody has counted.
peers.none: This node is on a network and is talking to nobody on it.
peers.lookedAt: Looked at {{time}}, and again every ten seconds.
peers.noMatch: No connected peer has that in its name or its address.

published.title: What this node publishes
published.body: Where it can be reached, and where the interface describes itself.
published.beASeedWhy: Draws the records whoever keeps the zone would have to publish. Nothing is published by pressing it.
published.seedRecord: Send this to whoever keeps the zone
published.seedRecordCheck: They choose the name and check it before publishing: that the key answering is the one in peer=, and that the record handed over starts with the act net= names.
published.noSeedRecord: This node has no place on the mesh, so there is no port for it to be a seed on.

claim.shown: Show this to whoever contributed this node. They approve it with their own key.

empty.notBundled: The agent is built from its own repository and staged into the bundle, and this build was made without one.
empty.notStarted: The agent has not been started.
empty.willNotStart: It is in this build and it would not run.
empty.stopped: It was running and it is not now. Asking something else starts a fresh one.
empty.ready: The agent is running and has been asked nothing. What you type below starts one.

conversation.adopted: Answering a question asked before this page opened. What it says cannot be shown here.

error.heading: That did not work.
error.agent_will_not_start: The agent would not start, so there was nothing to ask.
error.agent_stopped: The agent stopped part-way, so the answer never finished.
error.run_already_in_flight: The agent is already answering something. It does one thing at a time.
error.model_unreachable: Nothing answered at the model's address.
error.model_unknown: That address is serving, and it does not serve the model chosen in Settings.
error.resource_unknown: The agent was asked for something it does not hold.
error.unknown: The agent refused, and this build has no words for the reason it gave.

openAtLogin.heading: Open at login.
openAtLogin.label: Open Almena Node at login
openAtLogin.refused: The system did not accept the change, so the setting stays as it was.

model.heading: Model.
model.label: Model the agent asks for
model.inForceNone: Running now: nothing. The agent starts when you first ask it something.
model.restartHeading: This applies the next time the agent starts.

leave.heading: Leave the network.
leave.erase: Erase this node from this machine
leave.armed: Press again. The key, the record and the roots go, and this starts over.
leave.whileDown: The network is told first where this node can still say it. Where it cannot, it is erased anyway and the network finds it silent.
leave.notErased: The directory would not go, so the node is left whole.
leave.notErasedWhy: It could not be erased, and this build cannot say why.

cli.recordsNone: Not being written to a file. This node has nowhere it may keep one.

traffic.heading: Record traffic
traffic.measuring: Measuring… a rate needs two readings.
traffic.noMesh: No place on the mesh, so nothing is crossing it.
